itemUsage.en: Muelsyse, Rhine Lab Collaborating Operator. A strange, peculiar ecologist.
itemUsage.zh: 莱茵生命合作干员缪尔赛思，古灵精怪的生态学家。

itemDesc.en: Be careful. The one who stands before you is her, but also not her.
itemDesc.zh: 留意些，站在你面前的，是她又不是她。

description.en: In the early morning, long before the staff of the Ecological Section have come to work, a figure strolls through the vivarium. The vents have just opened, and the entire place quickly fills with mist. The figure remains at ease, briskly skipping about from plant to plant, occasionally tapping at the terminal on her chest before drifting to the next. After a full round, she chucks her terminal into a meeting room with a resounding 'clack' that fades away into nothingness. By the break of dawn, a line is already forming before a Trimounts bakery. Though most researchers care about meals only insofar as they fill stomachs and provide nutrition, inevitably a few would prefer to savor their food and drink. She is also in that line, hoping for freshly-baked bread and especially this bakery's salt-crust loaves. She glances at the queue in front of her, then at the big clock across the street. She then calculates how much longer it would take to have her fill of delicious bread... Muelsyse sits at the dresser, looking at her Dresser Flowing Shape while combing her hair. She has an Ecological internal meeting to attend in half an hour, but there is nary not a hint of worry on her face. Her Dresser Flowing Shape acts as a mirror and follows along with her movements. Occasionally, it decides to be a bit impish and changes its posture, to the consternation of its master as she tries to put on her makeup. After tying up her hair for the day and putting on whatever jewelry she feels like, Muelsyse flings her chapstick into her pocket before giving a wave to her Dresser Flowing Shape, which reverts to a fountain. Upon opening the door to her room, she sees some bread atop the table, along with a salad and some water. She enters Ecological, a gaggle of researchers surrounds her as she walks towards the meeting room. Newcomers are amazed that the director doesn't even need to glance at her notes before immediately going into presentation mode, while veterans have long since gotten used to this. After all, she is their director, predicting her actions is like trying to catch the wind. As such, almost none of them could imagine that at this very moment— She is in the vivarium, looking at a dewdrop form on the tip of a leaf. She is by a fountain in a city park, feeding the fowlbeasts. She is in the fountain on her dresser, where she continues to sleep. She is— 'I'm here, drinking coffee with you aboard Rhodes Island. 'Pretty amazing, right?' After seeing Muelsyse cross her arms and lift her head with pride, you hurriedly agree. You've seen her impressive abilities up close, although you have noticed a few... oddities in the small details— You've seen her press the wrong button on her terminal, forcing the vivarium staff to take cover from the sudden rain. You've seen her curiously take a bite of the feed in the park while feeding the fowlbeasts. You've even seen her draw an arc across her chin with chapstick. Skilled technicians controlling multiple terminals are bound to make mistakes, so it's only natural that Muelsyse would have trouble with multiple Dresser Flowing Shapes, right? But when you recall the sight of her stirring the air above her coffee cup, you can't help but laugh. As a result, and rightfully so, you suffer a one-two punch from Muelsyse's Dresser Flowing Shape.
description.zh:
时间还早，生态科的职员们还没上班，一个身影已经在生态园里闲逛了。喷口刚刚打开，整个生态园很快就满是水雾。那个身影感到很自在，她轻快地跳着，掠过一株株植物，时不时在怀里的终端上点几下，又飘向了下一个区域。就这样在整个生态园里逛了一圈后，她把终端丢进了会议室，“啵”的一声消失得无影无踪。

天刚蒙蒙亮，特里蒙的一家面包店门前就已排起了长队。虽然大部分科研人员对食物的要求是能填饱肚子，但总有那么些人，愿意多花些时间来计较吃喝。她的身影也在队列中，她想要吃新鲜出炉的面包，特别是这家店的脆皮盐面包。看了一眼前面的队伍，又瞥了眼街对面的大钟，她开始盘算自己还得等多久才能一饱口福……

缪尔赛思坐在梳妆台前，一边看着流形，一边梳着头发。
半小时后她就得列席生态科的内部会议，但她似乎并不着急。
小小的流形被当作镜子，随着本体的动作摇晃，偶尔起了玩心，流形也会摆个姿势，逗弄一下正在化妆的本体。
在纠结完今天梳什么发型，出门戴什么首饰后，缪尔赛思把润唇膏丢进口袋里，挥手让流形重新变回了喷泉。
打开房门，缪尔赛思看到了桌上的面包，除此之外，还有一份色拉，以及一杯清水。

一走进生态科，职员们便围了上来，簇拥着她向会议室走去。新来的职员还在惊讶主任什么都不拿就直接开始宣讲，老职员们早就对此习以为常了。
毕竟，他们生态科的主任是缪尔赛思，想要猜准她做了什么，想做什么，怕是比登天还难。
因此，他们大概也想象不到，在这个时间点——
她在生态园的一株植物的叶片下看着叶尖上的露水。
她在城市公园的喷泉旁，喂食着聚集在此的羽兽。
她在自己梳妆台的喷泉里继续睡着大觉。
她在——

“我在这里，在罗德岛上，陪你喝咖啡。
“怎么样，是不是很厉害？”
看缪尔赛思手叉着腰，把头昂得高高的，你也忙不迭地送上赞美之词。毕竟，她那神乎其神的本事你都亲眼见过，只不过，在一些“小细节”上，和你的见闻有点出入——
你见过她在操控终端时摁错键，弄得生态科的职员们在生态园里到处找地方躲雨。
你见过她在公园喂羽兽，鬼使神差地把羽食塞进了自己嘴里。
你甚至见过她拿着润唇膏，在下巴上画了一道弧线。
熟练的操作员在操控多个终端时都会出错，何况操控多个流形的缪尔赛思呢？
但你想到她之前拿着勺子在咖啡杯上空搅拌的样子，还是不禁笑了出来。
于是，理所当然地，你遭受了一顿来自缪尔赛思的流形连击。

description.en:
Carrying a cute umbrella is the best way to start a conversation.
People will ask about your leaf umbrella, turn the topic to themselves, sigh about how the seasons change, and how spring will eventually come. They always skip winter, and end the conversation on a positive note. Finally, you enjoy a dance with them. The dance is mandatory for new meetings. Many relationships begin with a dance, and Muelsyse never misses the opportunity for one.
But does she really need these 'opportunities' from those so-called 'networking' sessions?
The question is like a stone failing to skip across a pond. It falls into the water with a dull splash and sinks for eternity.
She changes one dance partner for another, and then another, her steps growing ever more graceful. Muelsyse once thought she could master every dance there was. She also once thought she had many 'friends' by her side. Until Kristen and Saria showed up.
The silent stone beneath the water became a pea under her mattress. Hidden for a so long, it finally got to shout out loud: Hey? Was that really what's been happening? Subvert your own expectations, and see what's true or false! It's time for fate to bring you some real 'like-minded' people!
It was a meeting arranged by her supervisor, with only two other people from a small laboratory.
We all know how it ended. The lab of two became a lab of three, and she was the first to join. Boom, 'Rhine Lab' was founded.
'No, no, no, this isn't right...' She had just finished writing her final thesis and had gone without a night of proper sleep for two weeks. She slumped over the table, '...We should try this method first, it has a higher chance of success!'
'This is why it's good to have a group of three. Let's take a vote.' Kristen from the other side of the table takes another sip of coffee, dark circles around her eyes. Saria nods silently.
'So, hands up if you agree with plan A.'
Kristen raises her hand, and so does Saria. A frown slides onto Muelsyse's weary face.
'Ugh... h-hands up if you're with plan B!' She raises her hand, her lonely arm standing aloft.
Immediately after, amid the sound of water, another hand raises. Followed by a second, and a third. The identical water clones look at their two companions, and the elf grins: 'Hehe, four to two, how 'bout that?'
'It's not fair...'
'Four to two, fair enough, no? This Muelsyse, that Muelsyse, and that Muelsyse are all members of Rhine Lab. They have the right to vote too.'
A reasonable point. A group of reasonable friends. Seems strange, but this is how those from Rhine Lab joke around. As for what came next, how the victorious water clones cheered in unison and spilled coffee onto Kristen's beautiful trench coat... we'll get back to that next time.
Amidst the shrieks and sorries, Muelsyse hears something. A quiet, subtle, moist, sound. A sprout emerging from the soil.
It was that pea—it had found the soil. It began to take root and sprout.
The seasons change, and spring will always come.
description.zh:
随身携带一把漂亮的好伞，是轻松开启社交最好的方式。
人们会问起这把树叶伞，然后把话题延展向他们自己，与你一同感叹四季轮换，春天总会到来。绝口不提冬天，让聊天终止于愉快的展望。最后你们去跳舞。聚会总是要跳舞的。许多关系都是由一曲共舞开始，缪尔赛思从不错过任何机会。
但——她真的需要那些所谓的“社交”带来“机会”吗？
这个问题像是没打成水漂的石头，咕咚一声闷闷沉下水去，永无止境地坠落。
她对面的舞伴换了一个，又换了一个，她的舞步也愈加熟练。缪尔赛思一度认为，她已经能够跳好所有舞蹈。缪尔赛思也一度认为，她身边拥有许多“朋友”。而后，克丽斯腾与塞雷娅出现了。
水底那颗沉寂的石子成了床垫下的豌豆。它隐没许久，终于可以开始高声喊叫——嘿？事情果真如此吗？颠覆自己吧，瞧瞧什么是真的，什么是假的！是时候了，命运会带给你一些真正的“志同道合”之人！
那是导师打发她去应付的会面，对方是个只有两个人的小型实验室。
结局我们都知道了，两个人的实验室变成了三个人的实验室，她是最初的加入者。“莱茵”就此成立。
“不不不，你们这个不对……”那时她刚赶完结课论文，连续半个月没睡一个囫囵觉，软趴趴地伏在桌子上，“……我们，应该先尝试这个方向，这个成功率更大！”
“这就是三个人的优势了，投票吧。”桌子另一侧的克丽斯腾又喝了一口咖啡，她的黑眼圈不浅。塞雷娅沉默地点头。
“那，同意方案A的，请举手。”
克丽斯腾举起手，塞雷娅也举起了手。缪尔赛思困倦的脸上浮现出一个皱皱巴巴的表情。
“唔……支持、支持方案B的，举手！”她举起手，一只孤零零的手臂在空中立着。
紧接着，水声之中又一只手举了起来。然后又一只。然后又一只。面目相同的水分身们看向两位伙伴，精灵姑娘咧开嘴一笑：“嘿嘿，四比二，如何呢？”
“考虑到我们的诉求是公平……”
“四比二，这很公平。这个缪尔赛思，还有这个缪尔赛思，以及这个缪尔赛思，都是莱茵的成员。她们具有投票权。”
很有道理的论点。很可靠的朋友们。虽然形式诡异，但这确实是莱茵人开玩笑的方式。至于后续，得胜的水分身们一齐欢呼，打翻咖啡彻底毁了克丽斯腾那件漂亮风衣的事情……我们下次再谈。
尖叫和抱歉声的吵闹之中，缪尔赛思听见一种声响，安静的、细微的、湿润的声响。植物胚芽从土壤中生长而出的声响。
是那颗豌豆，它找到了土壤，它开始生根，开始发芽。
四季轮换，春天总会到来。
